content.title: November CPI, Nike earnings, mortgage rates: What to Watch
content.description:
Market Domination Overtime host Josh Lipton previews several of the biggest stories to come tomorrow, Thursday, December 18, including the release of November's Consumer Price Index (CPI) report, the latest reading on mortgage rates, and earnings results from companies like Nike (NKE), FedEx (FDX), and Darden Restaurants (DRI).

To watch more expert insights and analysis on the latest market action, check out more Market Domination Overtime.
